title: elaeagnus longipes var. hortensis
intro: Elaeagnus longipes var. hortensis, commonly known as the Silverberry or Wolfberry, is a deciduous shrub native to East Asia. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, potentially aiding in the prevention of chronic diseases such as heart disease, diabetes, and certain types of cancer. The therapeutic actions of Elaeagnus longipes var. hortensis include its ability to act as an anti-oxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer agent, as well as its potential to improve cardiovascular health and immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
